name: OfficeQA
intro: OfficeQA（OfficeQA Full）以 1939–2025 年美国财政部公报为语料，覆盖约 89,000 页和超过 2,600 万个数值。246 道文档落地问题经独立复现、第三方裁决、两轮智能体问答复核与参数知识过滤后，分为 113 道 Easy 和 133 道 Pro。
build_method: 人工命题, 独立答案复现, 智能体辅助双轮质检
metric: 确定性正确率（精确匹配或绝对相对误差）
modality: 文本, PDF文档, 表格, 图表
task_type: 文档问答, 检索增强Agent任务
eval_feature: 真实文档检索, 多页推理, 确定性评分
scale: 246道问题（113 Easy + 133 Pro）；约89,000页；超过2,600万数值
build_method_en: Human Question Authoring, Independent Answer Reproduction, Two-round Agent-assisted QA
eval_feature_en: Real-document Retrieval, Multi-page Reasoning, Deterministic Grading
intro_en: OfficeQA (OfficeQA Full) is grounded in U.S. Treasury Bulletins from 1939–2025, spanning about 89,000 pages and more than 26 million numeric values. Its 246 document-grounded questions undergo independent answer reproduction, third-party adjudication, two rounds of agent-assisted QA, and parametric-knowledge filtering before being split into 113 Easy and 133 Pro questions.
scale_en: 246 questions (113 Easy + 133 Pro); about 89,000 pages; more than 26M numeric values
metric_en: Deterministic Accuracy (Exact Match or Absolute Relative Error)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.08655 and the official databricks/officeqa repository. The diagrams preserve the 1939–2025 Treasury Bulletin corpus (about 89,000 pages and over 26M numeric values), removal of embedded text layers, realistic multi-step question criteria, expert seed authoring and scaled annotation, USAFacts topical review, independent answer reproduction with third-annotator adjudication, two end-to-end agent-QA rounds with human conflict review, Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 parametric-knowledge filtering, and the final 246-question OfficeQA Full split into 113 Easy and 133 Pro questions based on two frontier agents. Evaluation retrieves original or OCR/parsed PDFs and uses deterministic normalization plus exact or absolute-relative-error grading with a default 0.0% threshold.
